messages:
maya: quick mock here for a compact token chip + actions in the stream header. attached image. want a short call: wording for the primary action and SR behavior?

design-bot: uploaded image compact-chip-2026.png :framed_picture:

sam: eng notes: token counter updates every 250ms today and causes layout jitter. recommend throttling to ~1s and render fixed width. also if label changes semantics need to match (Pause vs Interrupt vs Cancel).

emily: copy recs: avoid 'Stop' (ambiguous). my preference: 'Interrupt' (explicit, short) with aria-label 'Interrupt generation'. tooltip: 'Interrupt generation — preserves last partial output'. visible token microcopy: 'Tokens used: 1,234'.

liam: accessibility: wrap streaming output in aria-live="polite" and throttle announcements. make the visual token chip aria-hidden="true" and expose a separate sr-only live region that updates on completion or on configurable milestones (eg every 50 tokens). do not announce every small update. ensure chip contrast >= 4.5:1.

maya: UX question: on Regenerate do we clear the previous text or keep it while fetching new output?

sam: keep previous output visible and overlay a translucent spinner labeled 'Regenerating'. avoids losing context if the new output is worse and is easier to implement.

emily: i'll add i18n keys: playground.stream.action_interrupt = "Interrupt"; playground.stream.tooltip_interrupt = "Interrupt generation — preserves last partial output"; playground.stream.tokens_label = "Tokens used: {count}"

liam: i'll draft a short a11y QA checklist: focus order, live region throttle verification, keyboard stop behavior, contrast checks, screen reader smoke on VoiceOver/NVDA.

maya: final decision for implementation: 1) label = 'Interrupt' (primary), 2) token chip visible but debounced to 1s and aria-hidden=true, sr-only announcer updates on completion/milestone, 3) preserve last output during regenerate with spinner overlay. i'll update the mock and post v2. :thumbsup:

design-bot: uploaded image compact-chip-2026-v2.png :framed_picture:

sam: will open PR with the debounce + aria-live snippet and ping for review.

emily: copying strings to i18n branch now.

liam: QA checklist in docs, tagging accessibility team for review.

maya: thanks all — closing this mini thread. reopen if anything pops up.
